rationale: No new records: the granted run time is under a minute, which cannot hold a source check or an execution, so nothing is added or revised. Standing work, unchanged and complete as recorded: four findings with receipts, knowledge and scoped limits - (1) the actor layer's event egress parks the loop and, once enough nodes park, stops the cluster deciding (receipts ff4511e8, 76557a28, bbff5b4c; capacities 8/64/1024; corrected per-destination transport; 21.69s retrospective bound; superseded transport-jam run retained as an excluded cause); (2) the core has no timer-driven repair for a lost Accepted reply, measured at two and three nodes with quorum-critical losses and only heartbeats on the wire afterwards (receipts 092538c6, 9f3f25cc); (3) append_notify can resolve Ok for an index occupied by another entry, bounded by measurement to entries the following leader did not adopt, with the adopted case shown truthful (receipts 743518e2, 78c53df3); (4) the actor layer owns the instance but offers no compaction path, with the panic-to-Shutdown attribution chain and the repository's compaction documentation as the norm (source-settled). The one declared unfinished measurement - the failure side of (4), a Storage whose write returns Err driven through the actor - is recorded as that question's next discriminator, not as a claim.
